issue.title: Refresh or stabilize rich ANSI phase-show snapshot
issue.description: Repository-wide just test fails persistently at tests/test_bead/test_cli_show_style.py::test_show_closed_phase_with_markdown_rich_ansi_snapshot, including an isolated rerun. The current Rich rendering emits heading style ESC[1m where tests/fixtures/bead/show_style_closed_phase.ansi expects ESC[1;49m (and related background-style differences). This test and its golden were untouched while retuning model-alias defaults. Determine whether the renderer/dependency output should be stabilized or the intentional ANSI golden refreshed, then restore an exact passing snapshot.

payload.entry: Root cause: Console(force_terminal=True) still honored ambient NO_COLOR without no_color=False; c1efe9f93 masked it by rewriting the golden to degraded output instead of fixing the renderer.

payload.close_reason: Resolved by sase-dz.2: rich Console in cli_detail_prose._render_text now passes no_color=False so --color always beats ambient NO_COLOR; golden restored to its pre-c1efe9f93 highlighted form
